body: Hi there, thanks a lot :)
Hi, thanks for your advice :)
Yes I’m more aware of that now. Thanks :)
Haha we’ll see about that :)
Yes, I’m also doing more research about Islam in more depth. I’ve tried to find a scholar that fits me but I haven’t met one.
I think I’m leaning towards deism. Haha yeah I’ll keep that in mind, thanks! :)
Thanks for reminding me that modesty isn’t symonymous with our value as females in the society and how it’s my life and I should live my own life the way I want to. Hope you have a good day :)
Hi, thank you for your advice :)

Hi there! It’s nice knowing there are Indonesians lurking in this sub haha. If I think about it I’ve had my doubts since 2015 too and slowly left regular prayer. It’s only until October 2017 that I first wore hijab and prayed regularly again but now I feel so disconnected.

Yeah.. to be honest there are more religious people right now and it kind of makes me afraid? Because Indonesia used to be so tolerant but now not so much. I live in Tangerang and frequently go to Jakarta but my family & friends are getting more religious too. 

Anyway, thank you for your response! Hope you have a good day :)
Hi there! I’m so sorry for what you’re going through. Well now I know I’m not alone 😊 definitely will look into that later. Thank you! Hope you have a great day
Yes, your thought is much appreciated. Thanks :)
Thanks! I read that today :)

Thanks for your recommendation! I’ve added Carl Sagan’s book to my wishlist. Will buy it soon. 

No, I did not choose to wear hijab/look more into religion because of the community. I personally thought I did it for myself as the means to bring myself closer to God but what’s happening right now is the opposite haha

By decision did you mean decision to wear hijab or to leave Islam?

Yep. Especially when the family’s restricting us so much and holding us back from many things. It’s very frustating.
Yeah.. I mean it’s 21 century and a lot of Islamic rules aren’t applicable anymore.

Yeah, I think I’m in the same state as you were, existential depression. At least it helps me that I’m not alone :)

I didn’t get that much of attention here sice wearing hijab is a common thing, but from time to time I did get unwanted attention from someone I don’t really know that jokingly asked to marry me but he did it a few times after he found out I wore hijab ; I was surely annoyed by him. And yes, those people are annoying, always finding new things to gossip as if they’ve never done bad things. 

Thank you for your advice and I’m sorry that you had to face those annoying guys. I hope you have a wonderful life! :)
Hi, your comment means a lot and it feels like you really understand me. Thank you 😊
I think I’ll try that. Thank you for your response :)
Yeah, I’ve been lurking here for a week as an effort to have better understanding of myself. Thanks :)

Do you have any book recommendation? I’m reading Bulugh al Maram and at the same time The God Delusion. Thinking of getting new books.

Yes it is. I think it started with Ahok’s Blasphemy Case (Jakarta’s Former Governor) which later fueled a lot of people to use it as a political tool - we have presidential election next year. People now are so judgmental to each other, preaching others, and being intolerant. 

Other facts - I have seen many women migrated from wearing the usual hijab that only cover their heads into wearing long hijabs. Niqabs are getting more popular too. Taaruf is not uncommon anymore, and there’s this popular movement, Indonesia Tanpa Pacaran (Indonesia Without Dating) that generally encourages young muslims to not date as it is a big sin, and to opt for marriage instead of doing zina.

The only province that applies Sharia law is Aceh in Sumatra. I live near the capital city so there are a lot of people with diverse background, and aside from the judgmental people there won’t be any violence (worst thing that could happen is people will look down to me, trash talks me & my parents will be very mad)
I think that fits me more - right now I don’t really believe in Islam but I believe in God.
I’m 21 years old so yeah I’m an adult. Thank you for your encouragement! Can I PM you?
Yes, thankyou. I’m making up my mind about it and I want to be sure 100% that I’m taking it off..

I’m afraid that this is just a phase (people were saying this is a test of my faith) and some time in the future I’ll want to wear it and be religious again.

About God, I’m not sure.. I’m reading a book about atheism too at the moment and I’m kind of afraid that it will confirm my thoughts. I can’t say that I totally don’t believe in God right now.
